title: Real-Time Instanton Dynamics in a Triple-Well to Double-Well Homotopy
summary: We show that the singularities which the analytically continued double-well instanton develops in real (Minkowski) time are not an inherent feature of real-time tunneling solutions. Rather, they can be viewed as arising from a singular limit of a one-parameter family of regular real-time solutions. Using a linear homotopy between a triple-well and a double-well potential, we construct a family of potentials, parametrized by $p\in(0,1)$, whose real-time ($α=0$) instanton solutions are everywhere regular and bounded.
